title: Studio Scene Plan
description: Non-destructive scenes.json plan consumed by OpenMontage Studio's timeline editor. Scenes without media are planning-only (generated from narration) and are never exported as video until a media path is filled in. The approved narration WAV always defines the final duration via Ajustar ao WAV.

wav.description: Optional WAV path. Relative paths resolve against the plan file's directory. Loaders must never switch the editor's active WAV without explicit user confirmation.

media.description: Optional path to a local image or video file. Omit for planning-only scenes (no invented media). Relative paths resolve against the plan file's directory.

duration_seconds.description: Target hold for this scene. Quantized to whole frames at 30 fps on load; Ajustar ao WAV may rescale all durations to match the narration WAV.

transition_duration.description: Overlap for non-cut transitions, quantized to whole frames at 30 fps on load.

narration.description: Script segment spoken during this scene (planning aid).

source.description: Stock source adapter name (e.g. pexels, pixabay_video, wikimedia). Omit if not from stock.

source_id.description: Unique id of the item within the stock source.

creator.description: Photographer or author name for attribution.

license.description: License string (e.g. Pexels License, CC BY-SA 4.0). Wikimedia may be per-file.

metadata.description: Free-form provenance (for example generated_by). Not used by the renderer.
